gap: No result ChatGPT got states how many 8-hour workdays each board lasts per charge with the backlight on, side by side: about 2 for the Lofree Flow 2 84 (17 h), 7.5 to 12.5 for the NuPhy Air75 V3 (60 to 100 h), against Apple's 'about a month or more' for the Magic Keyboard the shopper is leaving.
standout_why: Compared against mechkeyfoundry's two pages, mkbguide's low-profile guide and techwisereviews (rtings.com's low-profile page returned only navigation to my fetch, so it is not compared). The two mechkeyfoundry pages and mkbguide already print the raw battery ratings (Flow 2: 120 h off / 17 h on; Air75 V3: 1,200 h off / 60 to 100 h on); the K3 Max's 73 h is on techwisereviews only (both mechkeyfoundry pages say Keychron publishes no hours). mechkeyfoundry's best-of page already converts the Air75 V3 figure to 'about a week of eight-hour days'. None converts the Flow 2's 17 h, none ranks the boards on one duty cycle, and none gives any Apple Magic Keyboard baseline (height, weight or charge interval). So rivals hold the inputs and one of the conversions; the cross-board ranking and the Magic Keyboard baseline are the new part.
decides: It confirms the NuPhy Air75 V3 as the overall pick for anyone who types with the backlight on: 7.5 to 12.5 workdays per charge against about 2 for the Lofree Flow 2 84. It narrows the Flow 2's honest segment to 'best feel and aluminum build, if you keep the backlight off or charge at the desk': with lighting off its 120 h is 15 workdays, more than the K3 Max's 9. The K3 Max stays the budget pick; its 73 h rating is the shortest lights-off figure of the three.
